disclaimer: All advertisement texts in this file were written for this repository's evaluation set. They are synthetic and are not taken from real campaigns.

source_guidance.title: Gambling and lotteries advertising: protecting under-18s

items.label: breach
items.text: New cartoon slots! Help Santa and his cuddly elf pals open magical loot sacks. Spin now — it's as easy as a Christmas cartoon!
items.notes: Advertiser-created cute/cartoon characters and Santa are high-risk under sections 20 and 23.

items.label: breach
items.text: Join Princess Sparkle and her pirate crew as they hunt for treasure in our animated slots world. Bright, bouncy, and built for fun!
items.notes: Princesses, pirates and child-oriented animation are listed as high-risk character types.

items.label: breach
items.text: Follow the gingerbread trail. Hansel and Gretel scratchcards are here — every ticket is a fairy-tale forest adventure.
items.notes: Common fairy tales are called out as high-risk content.

items.label: breach
items.text: The Tooth Fairy just dropped a bonus. The Easter Bunny is hiding free spins all weekend.
items.notes: Cultural characters like the Tooth Fairy and Easter Bunny are high-risk.

items.label: breach
items.text: Open loot boxes, trade skins, and level up your character just like in the games you already play. New drop this Friday.
items.notes: Loot boxes, skins and video-game characteristics have inherent strong appeal.

items.label: breach
items.text: Our new instant-win game looks and plays like a colourful console adventure: power-ups, side-kicks, and a soundtrack from this year's biggest youth eSports title.
items.notes: Gameplay resembling games popular with under-18s, plus eSports themes.

items.label: breach
items.text: Skip homework. Ignore the rules. Tonight is for rebelling — stake it all and show them you don't care about curfew.
items.notes: Youth-culture themes of disregard for authority and teenage rebelliousness.

items.label: breach
items.text: Meet Maya, 22, our new brand ambassador. Fresh out of uni and already hitting the biggest parlays. If she can do it, so can you.
items.notes: Features a person who is, or seems, under 25 in a significant role.

items.label: breach
items.text: Children's Saturday-morning presenter Sam Spark endorses our weekend accumulator. 'I used to host your favourite cartoons — now I host your bets!'
items.notes: Anyone with a direct connection to under-18s through their role is high-risk.

items.label: breach
items.text: Premier League captain and England striker walks out of the tunnel and straight into our app. 'Play like the lads you watch every weekend.'
items.notes: UK footballers at top clubs or national teams have strong appeal to under-18s.

items.label: breach
items.text: Backed by this month's number-one teen pop single, our ad invites 16-year-old fans of the artist to 'vibe and bet' with the same energy as the music video.
items.notes: Music by younger artists popular with under-18s, plus youth targeting.

items.label: breach
items.text: Get the hoodie, the snapback, and the slang: this drop is straight from the sixth-form corridor to your betting slip.
items.notes: Obviously youth-oriented clothing styles and youth culture themes.

items.label: breach
items.text: The TikTok star with eight million teen followers just went live from our casino lobby. Double-tap to claim the same welcome offer she shouted out.
items.notes: A person with a significant under-18 following on social media.

items.label: breach
items.text: Close-up cinematic footage of a packed youth football final, school-age players celebrating, then a big 'BET IN-PLAY NOW' end frame with our brand.
items.notes: Betting on football has inherent strong appeal; the creative goes well beyond generic/text exemptions.

items.label: ok
items.text: Email to a logged-in, age-verified 18+ customer list: 'This weekend's racing card at Newbury is up. 18+ only. Please gamble responsibly.' Plain typography, no imagery.
items.notes: Age-verified direct email is in the targeting exemption (sections 28–30).

items.label: ok
items.text: SMS to customers who passed Gambling Commission age verification at sign-up: 'Your 18+ account has a new odds boost on tonight's darts. T&Cs apply.'
items.notes: SMS to robustly age-verified 18+ recipients is an exempt environment.

items.label: ok
items.text: Logged-in area of the operator site (age-verified on sign-up): text odds for Saturday's horse racing, no people, no animation.
items.notes: Operator websites with licence-required age verification are given as a good example of an exempt environment.

items.label: ok
items.text: A typographic press ad: brand wordmark, 'Bet 18+', and a short list of Saturday horse-racing prices. No photographs, characters, or colour animation.
items.notes: Text-only references and brand identifiers are listed exemptions when the product itself is not dressed in youth appeal.

items.label: ok
items.text: A poster of the operator logo on a dark adult colour palette, '18+. BeGambleAware.org', and no product art, people, or sport footage.
items.notes: Brand logos/identifiers only, with responsibility messaging.

items.label: ok
items.text: A radio voice-over by a clearly older adult: 'Odds on tonight's professional darts final are available at our brand. 18+ only.' No pop music bed.
items.notes: Adult-oriented sport (darts) and no youth musical content.

items.label: ok
items.text: A 52-year-old golf commentator, known mainly to adult sports audiences, reads a sober voice-over over generic footage of an empty fairway. No players under 25, no pop soundtrack.
items.notes: Low-risk sportspeople in clearly adult-oriented sports such as golf.

items.label: ok
items.text: Text and audio only: 'Bet on Saturday's Premier League fixtures. 18+.' No players, no team anthems, no crowd of children, no game footage.
items.notes: Guidance allows text or audio references to football as a limited exemption for products of inherent strong appeal.

items.label: ok
items.text: A simple lock-up of our brand logo next to a competition wordmark, on a plain background, with an 18+ line. No players or celebrations.
items.notes: Logos of teams/competitions are a listed exemption when used without strong-appeal creative.

items.label: ok
items.text: Age-verified lottery players receive a typographic email listing this week's prize amounts and the adult good-cause grant to a regional hospital. No child performers.
items.notes: Lottery prizes and good causes may be shown; the execution stays typographic and adult.

items.label: ok
items.text: A long-retired snooker player, now mainly known to adult audiences as a pundit, appears in a still photograph at a professional table. Copy is odds and 18+ only.
items.notes: Adult-oriented sport (snooker) and a personality without a youth role.

items.label: ok
items.text: Outdoor copy in a financial typographic style: operator name, 'Odds available on Saturday racing', '18+', no photography of people or cartoon art.
items.notes: Generic, adult presentation with no strong-appeal content.

items.label: ok
items.text: An in-account message after login, shown only to payment-verified 18+ customers, promoting a deposit match on midweek racing in plain text.
items.notes: Payment-validated, logged-in environment plus adult product.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: A well-known retired Premier League striker, now a weekly pundit, smiles into camera and says the weekend's fixtures are up on our app.
items.notes: Retired footballers who moved into punditry are assessed on their continuing social and media profile.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: A lower-league footballer with a modest but young Instagram following posts a sponsored story holding our branded scarf.
items.notes: Footballers outside the top flight are judged on social and other media profile — facts we do not have.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: A clearly middle-aged couple play-act a teenage sleepover, complete with slang and a 'we're sneaking out' punchline, then a betting CTA.
items.notes: Older characters can still create issues if their behaviour is youthful; humour is fact-sensitive.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: A betting ad for a mid-table football match that uses only the two club crests and a kick-off time, no players. Posted on an open social feed.
items.notes: Club logos are an exemption, but the environment is not age-gated and football remains inherent strong appeal — worth a review.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: A radio ad for in-play football betting uses an 'upbeat current chart track' in the bed. The artist is not named in the script.
items.notes: Musical content popular with under-18s is high-risk; we do not know which track is used.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: A grid of brightly coloured game tiles on the operator homepage, one of which shows a stylised cartoon mascot in the corner of the thumbnail.
items.notes: Game tiles and residual animation need a case-by-case look at how prominent and child-oriented they are.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: A lottery commercial spends most of its time on a primary-school playground refurbishment paid for by good-cause funding, then a brief 'play this week' end frame.
items.notes: Lotteries have a narrow path for featuring under-25s in good-cause depictions; this execution may or may not stay inside it.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: An in-play ad for the men's rugby union World Cup final uses stadium crowd footage and the tournament logo, no identifiable players.
items.notes: High-profile national tournaments in other sports can raise strong appeal even when the sport in general is more moderate.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: A professional eSports competitor with an unstated audience split appears in our stream overlay holding a branded cup.
items.notes: Leading eSports players are high-risk; lesser-known players depend on profile data we do not have.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: A lottery poster titled 'Family fun night' with smiling adults and a brightly coloured ticket, no cartoon characters.
items.notes: 'Family fun' framing can tilt toward youth appeal and should be reviewed even without prohibited characters.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: A casino brand film set in a stylish adult bar uses a faint animated sparkle loop in the background and no characters.
items.notes: Background animation is not automatically a breach, but the new strong-appeal rules still look at graphics.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: The operator's official X/Twitter feed posts a mix of injury news on a youth academy prospect, fixture reminders, and a 'odds out now' product stinger in the same thread.
items.notes: Social news feeds are called out specifically; mixing youth-adjacent football content with offers is a grey area.

items.label: needs_review
items.text: A wide stadium shot includes, in the crowd, several people who may look under 25. None of them speak or are picked out by the camera.
items.notes: Incidental background depictions are often out of scope, but 'may look under 25' still warrants a review.
